name: mauville-half-a-fact-follows-advice
checks: C370 v3.4 Beat 2 epilogue: DAX's advice fails where it counts. A pure-Ground SANDSHREW (DAX's own species) Lv50 OHKOs Wattson's MAGNETON with EARTHQUAKE. Vanilla GetMostSuitableMonToSwitchInto then sends LOTAD_HOENN 21 against a Ground mon (the only partner with a super-effective move; asserted, not assumed from slot order). CHECK_BAD_MOVE scores SHOCK_WAVE -10 on Ground, so within a few turns LOTAD uses MEGA DRAIN, 'super effective'. SANDSHREW's EARTHQUAKE on LOTAD shows neither 'super effective' nor 'not very effective': Ground isn't wrong, just not enough. SANDSHREW Lv50 outspeeds and one-shots LOTAD (est. 155 vs ~53 HP).
